notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Tireless Tracker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
